# Free Backlink Generator Tool

> A free, client-side backlink generator. Paste one page URL and the tool fills
> 4,500+ backlink, ping, social-share and archive templates with that exact page,
> opens each target once from the visitor's browser, records whether the target
> loaded, and exports the list as CSV, Excel, PDF or TXT. No account, no backend,
> no stored URLs.

Canonical: https://backlink.is-an.ai/
Language: English
Owner: F9XR Team (https://f9xr.org), hello@f9xr.org
Last updated: 2026-11-25
Reviewed by: F9XR Editorial Team

## What the tool does

- Accepts http(s) URLs, bare domains and percent-encoded links, then trims and
  normalises the value before a run starts.
- Fills a static template library (backlink forms, ping services, social share
  endpoints, web archives) with the target URL.
- De-duplicates hosts, shuffles the order per run and honours an optional batch
  cap (100, 250, 500, 1,000 or all templates).
- Opens each target in one of four delivery modes: IFrame (default), Popup, Tab
  (optionally reused) or Ping through a public CORS proxy.
- Marks every target as loaded (tick) or failed or blocked (cross). Progress and
  concurrency are visible while the run is in progress.
- Exports the finished list as CSV, XLS, PDF or TXT, all generated in the browser.
- Produces a shareable run link that keeps the target in the query string.

## What it does not do

- It does not create editorial links, and it does not guarantee rankings.
- Most submissions are index discovery, ping, share and archive signals. Treat
  them as a crawling and discovery helper, not a replacement for outreach.
- It does not store URLs, runs or accounts on a server. There is no backend.
- It does not load analytics or advertising scripts.

## Key pages

- https://backlink.is-an.ai/ : the generator, the step-by-step guide and the
  backlink explainer.
- https://backlink.is-an.ai/how-it-works.html : the full technical guide to URL

- https://backlink.is-an.ai/report-problem.html : report a dead or unsafe target.
- https://backlink.is-an.ai/pages/privacy.html : what leaves the browser.
- https://backlink.is-an.ai/pages/terms.html : terms of use.

## On-device AI assist

The AI assist panel builds a link brief (topic, anchor suggestions, run plan and
a handoff prompt) from the URL structure alone, in the browser. No API key, no
model call and no upload. The prompt is meant to be pasted into whichever
assistant the visitor already uses.

## Safe use

Start with IFrame mode at five concurrent requests, keep runs small and gradual,
target pages the visitor owns, and check the strongest targets by hand before
repeating a run. Volume is not a ranking strategy.

## Structured data

The homepage publishes JSON-LD for Organization, WebSite, WebPage,
WebApplication, HowTo, BreadcrumbList and FAQPage, including a screenshot
ImageObject and the review date.
